generate.title: Generate an onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest collects facts about this repository with code — layout, packages, scripts, endpoints and the import graph — and one model call turns them into a five-part tour: architecture, critical paths, how to run, a reading path and first tasks. About 30 seconds, well under a cent.
